title: Longitudinal overview of the fetus in the uterus
description: A sagittal section through the uterus: the abdominal wall at the top, clear amniotic fluid around, and the fetal head, face and trunk lying in it.
author: Goleisureintl
changes: Photograph of a monitor. Cropped to the sonogram sector only (the on-screen header with a case number, the caliper menu and the monitor frame were removed). Converted to JPEG (quality 85). Display read 'GA=20W5T' before cropping.

title: Transthalamic view of the fetal head (BPD)
description: Axial section of the fetal head at the level of the thalami and cavum septi pellucidi. The skull is a symmetric oval and the midline echo splits it into two equal halves. The BPD caliper reads 4.61 cm.
author: Verma AK, Singh A, Lal P, Gupta R, Gambhir PS, Gupta N, Dwivedi D, Anand D. (Cureus 2025;17(12):e98575, doi:10.7759/cureus.98575)
changes: Converted to JPEG (quality 85). No cropping. The authors' own yellow annotation arrows, labels, calipers and measurement box are part of the published figure and were left in. Measurement shown: BPD 4.61 cm, 20w0d.

title: Head circumference plane of the fetal head
description: The same standard axial plane with the head circumference ellipse drawn: HC 16.73 cm and occipitofrontal diameter 5.78 cm, in keeping with about 19 weeks.
author: Verma AK, Singh A, Lal P, Gupta R, Gambhir PS, Gupta N, Dwivedi D, Anand D. (Cureus 2025;17(12):e98575, doi:10.7759/cureus.98575)
changes: Converted to JPEG (quality 85). No cropping. The authors' own yellow annotation arrows, labels, calipers and measurement box are part of the published figure and were left in. Measurement shown: HC 16.73 cm, OFD 5.78 cm, 19w3d.

title: Transcerebellar view of the fetal head
description: Modified axial plane angled down to show the normal cerebellum (measured 2.01 cm) and the cisterna magna (6.55 mm, normal is under 10 mm), part of the routine anomaly scan.
author: Wolfgang Moroder (Dr. Moroder, ecofetale.com)
changes: Cropped to remove the top header strip (patient/exam identifier, date and time) and the bottom status bar. Converted to JPEG (quality 85). Calipers and the measurement box were left in.

title: Four-chamber view of the fetal heart
description: Transverse section through the fetal chest showing the two ventricles and two atria, labelled RV, LV, RA and LA on the image. A normal four-chamber view shows four chambers of similar size and an intact septum.
author: Nevit Dilmen
changes: Scan of a printed sonogram. Cropped to the sonogram sector (removed the clinic name, date/time, ID field and the keypad legend). Converted to JPEG (quality 85). The gestational age is not recorded in the source.

title: Sagittal view of the fetal spine
description: The fetal back with the vertebral column seen as two parallel rows of bright echoes along the curve of the back. The head lies to the left of the picture.
author: Guimi
changes: Converted from PNG to JPEG (quality 85). No cropping. The on-screen text shows only machine settings and 'GA:20w1d'.

title: Sagittal view of the fetal spine (curved back)
description: A long curved section of the fetal spine showing the regular row of vertebral echoes along the back.
author: Nevit Dilmen
changes: Scan of a printed sonogram. Cropped to the sonogram sector (removed clinic name, date/time and ID field). Converted to JPEG (quality 85). Gestational age not recorded; the fetus fills the field, so it is probably later than 24 weeks.

title: Abdominal circumference view with stomach bubble
description: Transverse section of the fetal abdomen at the level of the stomach and the umbilical vein, with the ribs visible around it. The AC ellipse measures 13.82 cm.
author: Verma AK, Singh A, Lal P, Gupta R, Gambhir PS, Gupta N, Dwivedi D, Anand D. (Cureus 2025;17(12):e98575, doi:10.7759/cureus.98575)
changes: Converted to JPEG (quality 85). No cropping. The authors' own yellow annotation arrows, labels, calipers and measurement box are part of the published figure and were left in. Measurement shown: AC 13.82 cm, 19w2d; estimated fetal weight (Hadlock) 289.04 g.

title: Femur length measurement
description: The femoral shaft appears as a bright straight line with the calipers at each end, measuring 3.17 cm. The fetal urinary bladder is labelled nearby.
author: Verma AK, Singh A, Lal P, Gupta R, Gambhir PS, Gupta N, Dwivedi D, Anand D. (Cureus 2025;17(12):e98575, doi:10.7759/cureus.98575)
changes: Converted to JPEG (quality 85). No cropping. The authors' own yellow annotation arrows, labels, calipers and measurement box are part of the published figure and were left in. Measurement shown: FL 3.17 cm, 19w6d.

title: Mid-sagittal view of the fetal face and profile
description: The fetal face in profile with the nasal bone, nose, lips, mandible and maxilla labelled. The nasal bone length is 0.51 cm.
author: Verma AK, Singh A, Lal P, Gupta R, Gambhir PS, Gupta N, Dwivedi D, Anand D. (Cureus 2025;17(12):e98575, doi:10.7759/cureus.98575)
changes: Converted to JPEG (quality 85). No cropping. The authors' own yellow annotation arrows, labels, calipers and measurement box are part of the published figure and were left in. Measurement shown: nasal bone D1 0.51 cm. The source gives no gestational age for this image (the study covers 16 to 24 weeks).

title: Placenta on the posterior uterine wall
description: The placenta is the uniform grey mass on the far (posterior) wall of the uterus, with the abdominal wall layers at the top of the picture and clear amniotic fluid between them. Colour Doppler shows the umbilical cord vessels on its surface.
author: Wolfgang Moroder (Dr. Moroder, ecofetale.com)
changes: Cropped to remove the top header (patient birth date, exam time, clinic watermark) and the right-hand settings column. Converted to JPEG (quality 85). Gestational age 20w4d taken from the on-screen header before cropping.

title: Umbilical cord at the placental surface (colour Doppler)
description: Colour Doppler shows the umbilical cord vessels (red and blue) running over the placental surface, with central cord insertion and three vessels, as described by the author.
author: Wolfgang Moroder (Dr. Moroder, ecofetale.com)
changes: Tighter crop of the same source image as us_placenta (header and settings column removed). Converted to JPEG (quality 85). Gestational age 20w4d taken from the on-screen header before cropping.

title: Amniotic fluid pocket
description: The large black (anechoic) area between the abdominal wall and the placenta is amniotic fluid, a deep pocket free of cord and fetal parts. Fluid looks black on ultrasound.
author: Wolfgang Moroder (Dr. Moroder, ecofetale.com)
changes: Crop of the same source image as us_placenta, upper part only (header removed). Converted to JPEG (quality 85). Gestational age 20w4d taken from the on-screen header before cropping.
